label: Intervention axis
title: Transverse extent supports unbounded constant-support intervention rank under the separated-strip representation
kind: Exact representation/resource theorem and bounded replay
summary: Separated Rule90 strips provide arbitrarily many independently addressable two-cell interventions under one fixed 2D law. Even if a 1D target is allowed unlimited total storage, a fixed alphabet and fixed common local endpoint window can represent only finitely many independent channel actions.
takeaway: Independent transverse intervention structure is a complementary resource to nominal width or total state capacity: when total target length is unconstrained but one common local endpoint window is fixed, preserving it in one dimension requires local addressability resources to grow. This is an operational axis witness, not an intrinsic-dimension theorem.
